name: Gevotroline
summary: Gevotroline (WY-47,384) is an atypical antipsychotic with a tricyclic structure which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia by Wyeth-Ayerst. It acts as a balanced, modest affinity D2 and 5-HT2 receptor antagonist and also possesses high affinity for the sigma receptor. It was well tolerated and showed efficacy in phase II clinical trials but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a balanced, modest affinity D2 and 5-HT2 receptor antagonist and also possesses high affinity for the sigma receptor.

uses.text: Gevotroline (WY-47,384) is an atypical antipsychotic with a tricyclic structure which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia by Wyeth-Ayerst. It was well tolerated and showed efficacy in phase II clinical trials but was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: It was reported to be well tolerated in early trials, and little else is known. Antipsychotics that block dopamine D2 receptors can cause drowsiness, weight gain, restlessness and movement problems.
sideEffects.zh: 早期試驗報告它的耐受性良好，除此之外所知不多。阻斷多巴胺 D2 受體的抗精神病藥可能造成嗜睡、體重增加、坐立不安和動作障礙。
sideEffects.zhHans: 早期试验报告它的耐受性良好，除此之外所知不多。阻断多巴胺 D2 受体的抗精神病药可能造成嗜睡、体重增加、坐立不安和动作障碍。

fact.en: Gevotroline was developed by Wyeth-Ayerst and is one of many antipsychotics that worked in early trials but were dropped before reaching the market.
fact.zh: Gevotroline 由 Wyeth-Ayerst 開發，是眾多在早期試驗中有效、卻在上市前被放棄的抗精神病藥之一。
fact.zhHans: Gevotroline 由 Wyeth-Ayerst 开发，是众多在早期试验中有效、却在上市前被放弃的抗精神病药之一。
